Shreyas Iyer Reflects on Captaincy Record After Loss to England

Indian cricketer Shreyas Iyer has commented on a captaincy record following a loss to England. Iyer expressed his feelings about the defeat, stating it was the 'lowest you can go' and indicated he did not wish to single out any individual for blame after the match.
